justification: Policy v1_max36_25pct_cap120 on the full Cass history (402 months, 1990-01 onward via the Data Master splice, Step C #198; SPY bounds the aligned panel from 1993). min(max(36, round(402*0.25)), 120) = 100 months = 8.3yr OOS, above the 5yr reliability floor. After the #198 history extension the OOS window itself clears the 5yr floor; the winner is still found-in-search (the median valid combo underperforms buy-and-hold and the L9 lead is a likely search artifact, issue #28), but no longer for a short-OOS reason.
